mechanism_narrative: A lower federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) is associated with positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days due to reduced discount rates and increased liquidity in financial markets.
failure_condition: Rank IC between FEDFUNDS and 20d returns < 0.03 in any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: When unemployment rate (UNRATE) exceeds 5.0%, it signals a weak labor market that may prompt monetary easing, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: Rank IC between the UNRATE>5.0 signal and 20d returns < 0.03 in any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: When the economy is growing (GDPC1 > 11000) and unemployment is high (UNRATE > 5.0), it signals a potential for policy support and positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: Rank IC between the interaction signal (GDPC1>11000 AND UNRATE>5.0) and 20d returns < 0.03 in any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: During monetary tightening cycles (defined by FEDFUNDS rising and CPIAUCSL > 200), the S&P 500 produces negative forward returns over the next 20 trading days due to increased risk aversion and reduced liquidity.
failure_condition: Rank IC between the monetary tightening cycle signal and 20d returns < 0.03 in any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A lower federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) is associated with positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days due to reduced discount rates and increased liquidity in financial markets.
failure_condition: Rank IC between FEDFUNDS and 5d returns < 0.03 in any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: When inflation (CPIAUCSL) exceeds 200, it signals a high-inflation environment that may lead to monetary tightening, resulting in negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: Rank IC between the CPIAUCSL>200 signal and 60d returns < 0.03 in any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: When industrial production (INDPRO) is below 115 and housing starts (HOUST) are below 2000, it signals a weak economy, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: Rank IC between the interaction signal (INDPRO<115 AND HOUST<2000) and 60d returns < 0.03 in any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: During late-cycle expansion (defined by GDPC1 > 11000 and FEDFUNDS > 3.5%), the S&P 500 produces positive forward returns over the next 5 trading days due to strong economic growth and investor confidence.
failure_condition: Rank IC between the late-cycle expansion signal and 5d returns < 0.03 in any 2-year rolling window.
